finding: Manager -> HR -> sourcing pattern needed to be first-class and version-safe.
action_taken: Already addressed in PRM-F16, staffing model sheet, and governance docs.

checkpoint: Operational ownership and end-to-end value flow
finding: Earlier bundle underweighted process owner, customer, interfaces, and strategy linkage.
action_taken: Added PRM-F17, ADR-PROC-015/016, new governance models, and operational coverage matrix.

finding: Happy-path modeling alone would not survive large-enterprise exceptions and boundary handoffs.
action_taken: Added PRM-F18 and PRM-F21 with exception, conformance, and deviation handling.

finding: Original bundle had KPI language but needed harder separation between activity counts and outcome metrics.
action_taken: Added PRM-F19 and ADR-PROC-018 with wait/work/rework/customer outcome telemetry.

finding: Versioning without impact analysis and communication would permit unofficial live variants.
action_taken: Added PRM-F20 and ADR-PROC-019 with change requests, acknowledgements, and prioritization.

finding: Reality-review tooling must not become a rumor database about people.
action_taken: Added privacy-safe observation model, Security integration, ADR-PROC-020, and explicit non-goals.

finding: Earlier bundle still allowed too much ambiguity around whether future agent collaboration could be wired outside the modeled process.
action_taken: Added PRM-F22, ADR-PROC-021, new work-brief and triage entities, and explicit coverage for process-native baton routing.

finding: Live supervision on canvas is valuable, but the overlay must not become canonical state and future AI sessions must remain traceable to business context.
action_taken: Added PRM-F24, PRM-F23, ADR-PROC-023/025, overlay entities, and new risk controls for orphaned runtime context and projection misuse.

finding: The first bundle needed a harder stance on shared registries, future adapter placement, and process vs project model separation before AgentFramework integration begins.
action_taken: Added ADR-PROC-022/024/026, Workspace integration, stronger AgentFramework seam guidance, and explicit no-dual-registry/no-second-scheduling-language guardrails.
